page.overview:
What is Honeybee Inn?

Honeybee Inn is an entertainment venue located in the Wall Market in Final Fantasy VII and Final Fantasy VII Remake. Though based on the same location, the purpose of the venue is different between games. In Final Fantasy VII, the venue is a brothel, and in Final Fantasy VII Remake, the venue is a VIP night club that puts on coveted shows.

Honey Bee Inn is an optional location in the original game, though can be used to slightly improve Cloud Strife's crossdressing outcome in "To Corneo Hall". In the Remake, Honeybee Inn is visited during the main quest "Rescue Tifa" in Chapter 9, "The Town That Never Sleeps".
